verdict.rationale: Raygun documents ignore conditions on error groups (ignore for a time period, for a number of occurrences, or by rule), which mutes noisy errors such as those from a bad deploy. It also lists "Spike protection", but that feature is framed around detecting irregular data volumes to avoid surprise usage, not suppressing pages. missing for 10: per-key or per-app rate limits, spike protection explicitly tied to alert or paging suppression, alert-level throttling or dedup controls for PagerDuty/Slack notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.
